purpose: Defines the current, real developer CLI for Lumen: a synchronous binary that parses real session logs from every supported orchestrator and persists/queries them directly against the lumen-store SQLite database. Rescoped 2026-08-21 after a real-data audit found the CLI previously built (trace/audit/scan) matched none of this spec's original daemon-backed acceptance criteria and had zero wiring into lumen-store at all -- see reasoning for the full history.
scope: Covers crates/lumen-cli: CliApp's subcommand router (trace, audit, ingest, sessions, session), --json output, and the SQLite store path resolved via --db or a ~/.lumen/lumen.db default. Does not cover a background daemon, IPC, a TUI, or TOON output -- see non_goals.
non_goals: Database write locks or background worker execution (would be delegated to lumen-daemon, which does not exist as a crate in this workspace).
Active test suite running (delegated to prism-cli).

An async daemon-backed architecture (status, refresh, categories, insights, weekly, export, doctor subcommands; Unix-socket IPC; a TUI; TOON output via michi-toon). This was this spec's original scope before the 2026-08-21 rescoping and remains a legitimate future direction, but is explicitly deferred -- not built, not currently targeted -- until lumen-daemon exists and the current synchronous store-backed CLI's real command surface has proven out. Do not treat CRIT-LUMEN-090 through CRIT-LUMEN-098 in prior versions of this spec as current requirements; they described that deferred phase and were replaced below by criteria matching what's actually built.

api_surface.name: CliApp
api_surface.signature: pub struct Cli; impl Cli { pub fn parse() -> Cli; } fn main() -> miette::Result<()>
api_surface.description: Synchronous top-level command line router (clap derive), executing direct SQLite reads/writes through lumen-store's SessionRepository -- no daemon, no IPC.
error_conditions: IngestionError::UnrecognizedFormat if no orchestrator fingerprint matches the input file
A miette diagnostic if the resolved --db path's parent directory can't be created, or if a requested session isn't found in the store

api_surface.name: load_sessions / load_session
api_surface.signature: fn load_sessions(path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<CanonicalTranscript>>; fn load_session(path: &Path) -> Result<CanonicalTranscript>
api_surface.description: Fingerprints a file and dispatches to the matching adapter. Returns a Vec because OpenCode's real SQLite store commonly holds many sessions in one file, unlike the three JSONL adapters' 1-file-to-1-session shape; load_session takes the first for single-transcript commands.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN lumen trace <path> is executed against a recognized session file, THE SYSTEM SHALL render the session's per-turn trajectory (role, tool invocations, token counts) without touching the SQLite store.

WHEN lumen audit <path> is executed against a recognized session file, THE SYSTEM SHALL render the session's token economics breakdown, and SHALL display cost as an explicit unknown (never a fabricated dollar figure) when the session's model has no seeded PricingTable row.

WHEN lumen ingest <path> is executed against a recognized session file or a directory, THE SYSTEM SHALL parse every real session found, persist each via SessionRepository::upsert_session into the resolved --db SQLite store, and report which files/sessions failed to ingest rather than silently dropping them.
WHEN lumen ingest is executed against an OpenCode SQLite database containing multiple real sessions, THE SYSTEM SHALL persist one row per real session, not merge or drop any of them.
WHEN lumen sessions is executed, THE SYSTEM SHALL list sessions previously ingested into the resolved --db store via SessionRepository::list_recent, optionally filtered by --provider.
WHEN lumen session <provider> <id> is executed, THE SYSTEM SHALL display that session's full detail (model, turn count, token economics) read back from the store via SessionRepository::get_session.
WHEN any command is executed with --json, THE SYSTEM SHALL output valid JSON instead of a formatted table.
IF lumen session <provider> <id> is executed for a session not present in the store, THE SYSTEM SHALL return a clear error naming the provider and id, not a panic or an empty success.

IF no --db flag is given, THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve the store path to ~/.lumen/lumen.db and create its parent directory if missing, rather than requiring the user to run a separate initialization step.

reasoning: This spec originally described an ambitious async, daemon-backed CLI (10 subcommands including status/refresh/categories/insights/weekly/export/doctor, Unix-socket IPC to a lumen-daemon crate, a TUI, and TOON output). A 2026-08-21 real-data audit found: (1) lumen-daemon does not exist as a crate in this workspace: the daemon-backed architecture was flagged in project history as likely-inherited-fabricated scope from an earlier research pass, never independently re-validated; (2) the CLI actually built (trace/audit/scan) matched zero of the original 9 acceptance criteria and had no lumen-store dependency at all -- an untested gap that also meant the store's real-session round-trip had never once been exercised; (3) the user's explicit direction was to stop building a disposable test harness and instead grow the real product CLI incrementally, scoped to 'basic session info' as a genuine, load-bearing subset of the eventual full surface -- backed by SessionSummaryReadModel/SessionDetailReadModel, which already existed and were already spec'd in SPEC-LUMEN-003-STORE. This revision rescopes the spec to that real, synchronous, store-backed command set (trace, audit, ingest, sessions, session) and explicitly defers the daemon/IPC/TUI/TOON architecture as a distinct future phase (see non_goals) rather than leaving the spec claiming a scope nothing implements, repeating the original mistake.
